props.name: data
props.description: Ordered categories with name and count. Every category has an equal angle; petal reach and tone compare each count to the current maximum. Null, negative or non-finite counts remain unavailable in their category slot; zero leaves its track and zero label.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot aspect ratio.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills the containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
